lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate (1) to the long +y down-flange (4), about 90 deg. The 25/50/75% sections put the apex on the outer arc, 0.11-0.28 mm from the nearest cloud point. The line runs x -32.9..24.3 against flange extent -32.5..24.5, with no fold support beyond either end.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base plate (1) to the -y flange (9) right of the notch, about 90 deg. Sections show the apex on the outer arc, 0.03-0.13 mm off. Line extent matches flange 9 (x -13.8..13.1). Points past the start belong to plate interior at the notch, not to a fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Base plate (1) to the -y flange (10) left of the notch, about 90 deg. Apex is 0.01-0.22 mm off the outer arc. This fold sits about 4.6 mm off B2's line because the -y edge steps there, and it folds a different flange plate, so a separate line is correct. Extent matches flange 10.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1: base plate up into the joggle wall (outer skins 2 and 11), about 90 deg. Sections show the S-profile, with the apex on the outer arc 0.01-0.16 mm off. Fold support runs exactly over the line length, and at most about 2 mm is lost at the -y corner where it meets B2.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2: joggle wall to the raised plate (outer skins 3 and 12), about 90 deg. Apex is 0.04-0.24 mm off the outer arc, and the line spans the full width of the wall and raised plate.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Raised plate (3) to its +y down-flange (14), about 90 deg. It is collinear with B1 in plan but on a different plate at a different height, so a separate line is correct. Apex is 0.03-0.09 mm off the outer arc, and the extent matches flange 14 (x 29.1..48.6).

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Raised plate (5) to the end up-tab (15), with an included angle of about 94 deg. Apex is 0.02-0.11 mm off the outer arc. The line covers the full tab width (local y -4.8..6.5 against tab -5.2..6.2).
